title: ui-swallowed left presses now fall through to tray hit-test and Begin_Draw (the `if ui … else` chain was split)
detail: The 7.3 edit split `if ui {swallow} else {tray/drag}` into two statements. A popover/QoS-panel/chip-close press (ui=true, panel closed) now runs the tray loop and Begin_Draw; the queued Press_Anchor also resets press_swallowed, so unintended draw drags — and Drag_Release commits — fire through UI.
recommended_fix: Restore the gate: `if ui || inp.panel_open { /* suppressed */ } else { tray…/placement/Begin_Draw }` so a ui-swallowed press never reaches the tray hit-test or the world snap.

title: Shared package counter settings_test_seq is incremented from concurrently running @(test) procs — temp-path collisions
evidence:
app/settings_test.odin:15-23:
settings_test_seq: u64 // package counter — unique within the test binary

tmp_settings_path :: proc(t: ^testing.T) -> string {
	settings_test_seq += 1
	dir, derr := os.temp_dir(context.temp_allocator)
	if derr != nil {
		dir = "."
	}
	path := strings.concatenate({dir, "/pp-settings-test-", fmt.tprintf("%d", settings_test_seq)}, context.temp_allocator)
	os.remove(path) // a stale file must never leak into the test

(file has 13 @(test) procs; odin test runs @(test) procs concurrently on separate threads)
detail: `odin test` executes the 13 tests concurrently; the non-atomic read-modify-write of settings_test_seq can hand two tests the same sequence number, so one test's os.remove/save clobbers another's fixture on the shared path — flaky failures.
recommended_fix: Make the counter atomic (core:sync) or derive a unique path per test from the test name / os.create_temp_file style API instead of a shared package variable.

title: Keyboard S cannot close the settings panel while a pipe is selected, though the panel advertises "S / tap chip to close"
detail: Panel opened with a pipe selected (chip tap / pad Y) leaves sel_pipe >= 0; S is then never collected, so the advertised close key is dead (Esc/pad/chip still work). The mutual-exclusivity rationale covers only opening, not closing.
recommended_fix: Collect .S when `inp.panel_open || inp.sel_pipe < 0` — the modal key branch already routes S to Toggle_Settings only while the panel is open, preserving the lane-key meaning when closed.

title: Bottom-left report block half-scaled: SLA row pitch and pool-gauge geometry stay raw while their fonts scale — text overlaps at ×1.25/×1.50
evidence:
app/main.odin:1537 (scaled in this diff):

app/main.odin:1396-1398 (NOT scaled):

}

app/main.odin:1172 (NOT scaled):
		rnd.draw_pool_gauge(&app.view, &app.state.flow, &app.cat, app.drop_marks[:], app.tick, 12, app.view.win_h - 118)
detail: At ×1.25 (720p): header y=600 with 20px font vs pool label y=602 (raw 15px) — text-on-text at x=12. Row pitch stays 16px while the row font becomes 20/24px — the two live class rows overlap at ×1.25/×1.50. Legibility AC at the knob's own steps fails.
recommended_fix: Thread hud() through sla_row_y's pitch/anchor and the pool gauge's y-anchor + internal geometry (visibility.odin), keeping the whole report block on one scaled grid.

title: Phase-1 key buffer holds 10 slots but 11 distinct keys are collectible in one frame — the 11th silently drops
detail: A scripted/synthetic frame pressing all phase-1 keys at once (11 distinct, D included in PP_DEBUG builds) overflows the fixed buffer; the bounds guard prevents memory corruption but drops one key silently — e.g. Esc can vanish.
recommended_fix: Size keys to the true collectible set ([12]) or coalesce/document the drop order so no world-affecting key (Esc) can be the silently dropped one.
